section_summary.extract_value: This conclusion section describes a study examining interpersonal and intrapersonal links to body appreciation among college women, with body appreciation serving as a mediator between various psychological variables and intuitive eating. The study found that body appreciation did not predict unique variance in depressive symptoms, suggesting it is distinct from negative body image. The authors recommend exploring similar models with diverse samples to better understand body appreciation across different populations.
